evidence: Every candidate in the corpus carries its deciding rule: 986 ignored, 338 repository, 142 self-marker, 49 content, 3 manifest, 29 tracked and 27 unresolved across 47,536 directories walked.

The tracked rule runs before every other rule and refused 29 directories with output names that the repository tracks as source, including ~/localGit/echo/scripts/build and ~/localGit/disk_steward/.swiftpm. The fixture self-test asserts this case and passes 8 of 8.

1,468 of 2,615 output candidates lie outside any repository. The parent-manifest fallback resolved 20 of them and left 1,448 unresolved; self-marker and content evidence reduced that to 27, and the note states why those 27 stay unclassified rather than guessed.

Assurance reviewed: IMPACT-RESEARCH-601-BUILD, IMPACT-RESEARCH-601-ASSURANCE confirmed; INSPECT-RESEARCH-601-1 performed after the implementation event and sufficient; scope drift reconciled to those impacts; rollback is revert-only and monitoring is not applicable for a tool that does not run in the product, both recorded with the task that must replace them.

limitations: One corpus on one macOS machine; coverage of the rules elsewhere is unmeasured.
Measurement only: no product code consumes these rules until TASK-611.
The auditor also performed the research; independence rests on the archived per-candidate records and the fixture self-test.
